name: Fleet Guard
description: An AI-powered fleet monitoring system that analyzes vehicle activity, detects risks, and provides intelligent operational insights through automated workflows.
problem: Manual fleet monitoring was reactive, slow, and prone to missed incidents.
solution: A real-time AI system that analyzes fleet activity, detects risks, and provides instant operational insights.
impact: Reduced incident response time from hours to minutes.

name: Lease Intelligence System
description: An intelligent document processing system that extracts important lease clauses from PDFs and converts unstructured documents into structured business data.
problem: Manual lease review was slow, inconsistent, and easy to miss critical clauses.
solution: Automated extraction of important lease information from PDFs with structured summaries.
impact: Reduces manual document review time by 80%.

name: Document Intelligence Pipeline
description: An automated document processing pipeline that receives documents, extracts information, classifies content, validates data, and routes results automatically.
problem: Teams spent hours manually processing incoming documents.
solution: An end-to-end automated pipeline using n8n and LLM-powered analysis.
impact: Reduced turnaround time from days to minutes.

name: Client Onboarding Orchestrator
description: An intelligent onboarding system that captures leads, qualifies prospects, automates communication, and organizes customer data.
problem: Manual client onboarding was fragmented across email, spreadsheets, and multiple tools.
solution: An intelligent onboarding system with AI-driven lead scoring and automated follow-ups.

name: Smart Product Matcher AI
description: An AI-powered product matching and data cleaning system for e-commerce and inventory management.
problem: Duplicate, inconsistent, and incomplete product data across multiple platforms.
solution: AI-powered product matching, deduplication, cleaning, and enrichment system.
impact: Eliminates product data inconsistencies and saves hours of manual cleanup weekly.
